report: [DATE]: MR Knie Rechts 15ch AA: Klinische inlichtingen: Zie gescande aanvraag Diagnostische vraagstelling: Zie gescande aanvraag Bevindingen: Geen hydrops. Kleine onverwikkelde bakercyste. Normale quadricepspees. Normale patellapees. Normaal vetplan van Hoffa. Intacte voorste kruisband. Intacte achterste kruisband. Intacte mediale meniscus. Intacte laterale meniscus. Intact mediaal collateraal ligament. Intact lateraal collateraal ligament. Geen majeure kraakbeendefecten patellofemoraal. Geen majeure kraakbeendefecten lateraal femorotibiaal. Kleine ondiepe parti ële dikte kraakbeenfissuren centraal en centraal op de mediale femurcondyl. Geen botoedeem. CONCLUSIE: Kleine ondiepe parti ële dikte kraakbeenfissuren centraal en centraal op de mediale femurcondyl. Kleine onverwikkelde bakercyste. Verder onderzoek binnen normale grenzen.

In the medial compartment, there is horizontal tear at the body and radial tear at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
  
 The lateral compartment, there are small radial tear at the body and large radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is osteochondral injury at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 1.8* 2.2 cm). 
  
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact. 
  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is anterior tibial translation. 
  
 The medial collateral ligamentous complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
  
 There is grade II ligamentous sprain (partial tear) (chronic) of the lateral collateral ligament. Partial tear of the intraarticular portion, popliteus tendon. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. There are tears of the meniscopopliteal fascicles.  
  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
  
 Large amount of right knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is bone contusion at the posteromedial tibial plateau.   Osteochondral injury at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 1.8* 2.2 cm) of right knee.

Laterales Kompartiment:

Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Na seriji MR presjeka lijevog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala kolateralnih
ligamenata, prednjeg i stražnjeg križnog ligamenta i iliotibijalnog traktusa.
Kompleksna ruptura trupa medijalnog meniska, čija se horizontalna komponenta koja doseže
donju artikulacijsku plohu pruža u stražnji rog meniska. U području stražnjeg roga komunicira sa
slobodnim rubom meniska, gdje se nalazi parameniscealna cista duž stražnjeg aspekta stražnjeg
roga medijalnog meniska promjera do 2 mm.
Korpus medijalnog meniska periferno je potisnut izvan zglobne pukotine.
Lateralni menisk uredne je morfologije i intenziteta signala.
Entezofitoza pri inserciji tetiva m. kvadricepsa i ligamenta patele. U distalnom dijelu lig. patele
nalazi se ukopano koštano tijelo dimenzija 12x6 mm - stanje po Osgood-Schlaterovoj bolesti.
Plitke fisure i defekti hrskavice medijalnog kondila femura i tibije te lateralne fasete patele
(hondromalacija 2. stupnja prema ICRS klasifikaciji).
Fisure i raslojavanje pune debljine hrskavice lateralnog kondila tibije (hondromalacija 3. stupnja
prema ICRS klasifikaciji).
Ostale prikazane artikulacijske hrskavice urednih su intenziteta signala.
Manja količina izljeva u koljenu, manja poplitealna (Bakerova) cista.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

МР находка: МР данни за Bucket-handle лезия на медиалния менискус. Голяма част от менискуса е отлепена и се проектира медиално към интеркондиларната еминенция. МР данни за пълна руптура на предната кръстна връзка с давност. Самата връзка не се изобразява. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Нормално изобразяване на задната кръстна връзка. Колатерални лигаменти – б.о. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става, са с нормална форма и сигнален интензитет. Ставният хрущял на тибията, фемура и пателата е интактен. Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – б.о. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Няма данни за ставен излив. Заключение:  МР данни за Bucket-handle лезия на медиалния менискус. Руптура на предна кръстна връзка.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: [REDACTED].
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion with synovial proliferation. No intra-articular bodies. Small Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tear of the body extending into the body-posterior horn junction with mild extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Low-grade cartilage loss at the weightbearing aspect of the medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness cartilage loss with subchondral cystic change at the inferomedial trochlea. Fraying with high-grade fissuring and delamination at the medial patellar facet.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Complex tear of the medial meniscus body extending into the body-posterior horn junction with mild extrusion.
2.	Mild medial and patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.

There is a mild knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  ACL is ruptured in its mid substance. There is mild residual bone contusion in the weightbearing aspect of the lateral femoral condyle and posterior aspect of the lateral tibial condyle. Mild anterior translation of the lateral tibial plateau is seen in relation to femur.  Normal PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  The tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage is normal. Normal visualized remaining bones and surrounding soft tissues.  Conclusion: ACL rupture.

МР находка: Няма данни за ставен излив.  Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става, са с нормална форма, структура и сигнален интензитет. Липсват зони на костномозъчен едем. МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – 3 стадий под формата на хиперинтензна лезия с кос ход достигаща до артикулиращата повърхност на тибията. В задния рог на латералния менискус не се виждат дегенеративни промени или менискални увреди. Предните рога са интактни. Нормално изобразяване на кръстните връзки. Ставният хрущял на тибията и фемура е интактен, със запазена конгруентност. Колатерални лигаменти - б.о. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Патела, хрущял на пателата – б.о. Нормално изобразяване на меките тъкани. Заключение:  МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 3.

Horizontalna pukotina stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska. Lateralni menisk, te prednji i straznji
krizni ligament odrzani.
Vidi se povišeni intenzitet signala pri femoralnu hvatištu MCL-a što može odgovarati stanju
nakon distenzije. Održan je kontinuitet MCL-a. Također se vidi povišen signal prema patelarnom
hvatištu MPFL-a sa lateralnim tiltom patele, upućuje na distenziju/ili intersupstancijsku rupturu
MPFL-a. LCL urednog prikaza.
Vidi se da su prikazane koštane strukture urednih MR signala, a zglobni odnosi kongruentni.
Artikulacijske hrskavice FT i FP su primjerenih MR karakteristika.
Bez izljeva, bez Baker ciste.
